d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Kisan Conference, highlighting the government's efforts to protect farmers from rising fuel prices and economic challenges. During his speech, PM Modi claimed that diesel prices, which could have increased by Rs.50 per litre, were raised by only Rs.7. He explained how government policies and decisions helped reduce the financial burden on farmers. What was the context behind this statement? What measures did the government take to support the agricultural sector? Watch this report for the key highlights of PM Narendra Modi's address, his claims on…
